structured_output.what_is_happening: A 10.5-hour-old pump.fun coin, 'running cow' ($cow), still on its bonding curve (90 of about 115 virtual SOL), jumped +143% in 5 minutes to about $29.5k market cap. Most of its 1-hour volume ($21.6k of $25.6k) happened in that 5-minute window. GeckoTerminal's newer 5-minute window already shows -15%, with 5-minute volume down to about $4k from about $25k over 15 minutes. Price is about 19% below its all-time high of 3.66e-5. The only project links point to X posts (a nocontextmemes post and a chillmigratoor post), which suggests the coin is built on a viral 'running cow' meme clip. At least 7 copycat 'The Running Cow' tokens were launched 4 to 8.5 hours after this one. That makes this coin the earliest pump.fun token on the meme in the packet. Its creator wallet is a serial launcher (5,435 tokens) that has already sold out (creator_close, balance 0). Bundler activity is very high: 209 bundler-tagged wallets, and bundler-tagged traders make up 47% of top traders. There are also 13 smart and 4 renowned wallets.

narrative.description: A viral 'running cow' meme clip (linked to a nocontextmemes X post). This is a pure attention meme with no project behind it. The copycat launches show the meme drew enough attention to get several tokens deployed, but most copies died under $6k, and one reached about $65k before going to zero liquidity.
narrative.why_spreading: The meme had enough reach to spawn copycat launches over the evening. The current spike looks like a revival pump on the oldest token rather than fresh growth of the meme itself: the copies have no volume now, and the clip is about 10 hours old.

token_connection.why_this_token: It was deployed first among the 'running cow' tokens (created about 17:10 UTC, versus 21:46 UTC to 00:07 UTC for the copies), it links to the source post, and it is the only one with meaningful liquidity and volume now.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 7 'The Running Cow'/'RUNNING COW' copies, all with 0 liquidity, mostly $3k-$5k market cap, one at $65k. The CoW Protocol and Perpetual Cow tokens with the same ticker are unrelated.

authenticity.evidence: 209 bundler-tagged wallets, with bundler-tagged traders at 47% of top traders and a 57% bot/degen rate. The dev is a serial launcher with 5,435 tokens that already exited. The volume burst came almost entirely inside one 5-minute window and immediately cooled. 131 unique buyers in 15 minutes does suggest some real participation, and 13 smart plus 4 renowned wallets are present.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data, so I can't see whether the meme is re-trending organically. The smart/renowned wallets may have bought early and could be exit liquidity for the bundlers, or the other way round.

structural_risks: A heavy bundler share lets a coordinated group dump into the curve
The volume spike is already decaying, and the latest 5-minute price change is -15%
GeckoTerminal and RugCheck liquidity figures disagree ($9k vs $21k), so the book may be thinner than it looks
Doubling from entry needs about $55k-60k market cap, which means migrating past the curve and surviving the usual dump after migration

structured_output.counterargument: This is the earliest token on a meme that clearly spread (7+ copycats), it sits close to migration (90/115 SOL), and there are 131 unique buyers in 15 minutes with smart and renowned wallets present. Coins that are first on a meme and close to finishing the curve often get a second leg when they migrate, and $30k to $60k only takes about $30k of net buying. If entry comes after a pullback to about $22k-25k, even retesting the all-time high and migrating could get close to 2x.

structured_output.thesis: This coin is first on a real but aging meme, but the spike looks bundler-driven and it is already cooling within minutes. The dev is a serial launcher who has already exited. From an entry 25 minutes after detection, the -50% stop (about $12k-15k market cap) looks more reachable than a doubling to about $55k-60k.
